The '''Plasma TV''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can be purchased from the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|4500}} after upgrading the [[Farmhouse]] for the first time. It is also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}. As with other [[television]]s, players can view [[television]] programs by {{key|right-clicking}} on the Plasma TV.

It offers no advantages over the [[Budget TV]] or [[Floor TV]] (such as extra channels) other than a larger viewing screen. This does however make it easier to see the icons on the screen, such as the weather forecast. It also has a 3x1 floor footprint rather than a 2x2 footprint (Budget TV and Floor TV).
